active_watches.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Watch issued November 1 at 4:11PM MST until November 1 at 9:00PM MST by NWS Albuquerque NM
active_watches.description:
THE NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE HAS ISSUED SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH
699 IN EFFECT UNTIL 9 PM MST THIS EVENING FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN NEW MEXICO THIS WATCH INCLUDES 8 COUNTIES

IN CENTRAL NEW MEXICO

LINCOLN               SOCORRO               TORRANCE

IN EAST CENTRAL NEW MEXICO

GUADALUPE

IN NORTH CENTRAL NEW MEXICO

SANTA FE

IN NORTHEAST NEW MEXICO

COLFAX                MORA                  SAN MIGUEL

THIS INCLUDES THE CITIES OF ALTO, BONITO LAKE, BOSQUE DEL APACHE,
CLINES CORNERS, CONCHAS, ESTANCIA, GRAN QUIVIRA, LAS VEGAS,
MCINTOSH, MORA, MORIARTY, MOUNTAINAIR, RATON, RUIDOSO, SANTA FE,
SANTA ROSA, SOCORRO, SUGARITE, AND WAGON MOUND.
